_meta.source: nutlope/hallmark slop-test gates + Laith0003/ux-skill anti-patterns.json (152 entries) + WorqAI anti-slop copy rules.

banned_css_patterns.why: gradient panels/text are the top AI tell (hallmark gate 2)
frosted-glass blocks read as generic SaaS template

banned_composition_notes: Dashboard/card grids, generic SaaS panels, fake analytics, floating UI, decorative diagrams.
Re-drawn browser/phone/IDE chrome - use real screenshots.
Invented metrics - a number appears only if a real source shows it.
Generated images containing readable text, logos, CVs, emails, or fake product screens.
